uslaw-usc-t2-s288n: Section 288n of Title 2 of the United States Code deals with the costs of travel for the Senate Legal Counsel. It sits in Chapter 9D, on the Office of Senate Legal Counsel. Funds spent by that Counsel for travel, and for costs that go with travel, are the subject. Those funds are to be bound by the same rules and bounds as a set of Senate funds. The rules are those set by the Committee on Rules and Administration for travel paid from the contingent fund of the Senate.
